call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished flat portrait poster, aspect ratio 2:3.

Create an evocative nighttime garden poster. The garden is one coherent place with continuous rooted vegetation, not a floating arrangement. View it from the near entrance at low standing eye level: a narrow dark earth opening recedes from the bottom center into dense planting, with overlapping leaf masses and flower beds at several depths. Large foreground leaves crop naturally at the left and right edges. Recognizable pale ivory open flowers and a few muted violet blossoms emerge from connected stems and dark green foliage. Their visible petals reveal the garden's depth; darker growth remains connected between them.

Use a restrained botanical photographic image with convincing plant structure, delicate petal surfaces, varied leaf reflectance and soft night shadows. A single soft cool light from high left selectively catches flower faces and the upper edges of leaves, then falls off with distance. Preserve deep blue-black shadows. The flowers do not emit light. Avoid artificial glowing particles, lens flares, bokeh confetti, starry sky, decorative halos, extra props or invented architecture.

Typography and spatial relationship: render the sole Korean title exactly once as a substantial, crisp, warm ivory Korean serif title on one horizontal line. Position it across the near threshold of the garden in the lower part of the image, aligned with the opening where the viewer enters the receding plant field. The title should feel like the visual boundary into this dark place, with the garden extending behind and above it. Its width and contrast should relate to the surrounding pale flower heads, without becoming a separate boxed header or footer. Keep all letter strokes intact, with intentional even spacing within words and clearly wider spaces between words. No plant crosses a letter. The title is flat printed typography, without bevel, embossing, glow or shadow.

The complete and only printed text is:
밤에 피는 정원

Preserve all six Korean syllables and the two word spaces. Print no quotation marks, no translation, no additional words, captions, dates, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks or decorative marks. No border, no panels, no contact sheet, no framed wall display, no product mockup. One single independent edge-to-edge 2:3 poster.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
